Name: Phone Villagers
Author: dewmods
Description:
[u][b]DETAILS
[/b][/u]You will need at least 5 hearts of friendship with the villager to get their number before you can call them. Each call on the JOJA Network now costs 5G, regardless if the call was successful or not!

Thanks for viewing my first mod! I hope you enjoy it :)
[u][b]
INSTRUCTIONS
[/b][/u][list=1]
[*]Open the in-game menu
[*]Open the Social menu tab
[*][b]Right-click[/b] the villager you'd like to call
[/list]
[b][u]FAQ
[/u][/b][b]1. How do I call NPCs?
[/b]Open your in-game menu and go to the "Social" menu. Then right-click the row of the NPC you'd like to talk with.

[b]2. Does this add new dialogue?[/b]
Not for the NPCs.
Dialogue prompts have been added to let the player know if a call is unsuccessful in situations where the NPC is unavailable, or the player does not have enough money to make the call.

[b]3. Does this improve friendship?[/b]
Yes, this will add the same amount of friendship as talking to the NPC directly.[b]

4. How much does it cost per call?[/b]
5G[b]

5. Will I lose 5G even if the call is unsuccessful?[/b]
Yes!

[b]6. Can I send gifts to Villagers using this mod?[/b]
No, this has been disabled to prevent players from accidentally gifting their active inventory items.

[u][b]REQUIREMENTS[/b][/u]
Stardew Valley 1.5.6 Hotfix #3
SMAPI 3.18.2

[u][b]INSTALLATION[/b][/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download the mod file
e.g. "[i]PhoneVillagers 0.5[/i][i].zip[/i]"

[*]Extract the contents of the mod file to your Stardew Valley mods folder
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\"
[/i]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley (must launch using SMAPI[i])[/i]
[/list]
[u][b]CONFIG
[/b][/u]Default config.json
[code]{ 
  "MinimumHeartsRequired": 3, 
  "CostPerCall": 5
}
[/code][u][b]
[/b][/u]MinimumHeartsRequired
[list]
[*]Minimum friendship points with the NPC before calls can be made.
[/list]CostPerCall[u][b]
[/b][/u][list]
[*]Amount of G that will be deducted per call.
[/list]
